caught.title: This was a phishing simulation
caught.body: No harm done — this was a safe test run by your organisation. Here is what gave it away:
caught.reportedBody: Reporting suspicious messages is exactly the right move. Here is what to keep watching for:
tips: Check the sender's address, not just the display name.
Hover over links before clicking to see where they really go.
Be wary of urgency and unexpected attachments.
When in doubt, report it instead of clicking.

home.title: Train your people against phishing, safely.
home.lede: Baitward lets a company test and train its own employees with controlled, authorized simulations — measuring who opens, clicks and submits, and teaching the moment someone slips.
home.featuresHeading: Everything you need to run a safe simulation

campaigns.title: Campaign engine
campaigns.desc: Build bilingual templates and drip simulated emails to the right people at a safe rate.

tracking.title: Real-time tracking
tracking.desc: Watch opens, clicks and submits land in a live funnel, broken down by department.

training.title: Instant training
training.desc: The moment someone clicks, they get a short lesson and a quiz — teaching, not shaming.

reports.title: Audit-ready reports
reports.desc: Export bilingual PDF reports and track a human-risk score per employee and team.

privacy.title: Privacy by design
privacy.desc: Submitted data is never stored — only that a form was submitted, plus technical metadata.

bilingual.title: Turkish & English
bilingual.desc: Every screen, email template and training lesson is available in both languages.

home.guarantee: Submitted data is never stored. The fake form POST is captured, its body discarded, and only a "submitted" event is recorded.
